sourceFile: 23.BRS-MSU L20S15-07  LIST TEST IMPROVE NG FUNCTION_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it collapses many distinct test changes into one filename factor and converts plan text/dates into false measurements.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not the actual tested changes.
Multiple independent test items are wrongly merged into one comparison context.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked unknown despite row-level conditions.
Outcomes and stats are fabricated from text, dates, quantities, and headers.
Actual result evidence is mostly missing or not grouped with Sheet2 data rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Should this plan list be treated as final validation evidence or only test-planning context?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factors from each test item and content row, preserving coil, frame, yoke, AWF, jig, and date context.
Separate baseline normal conditions from changed frame, coil, yoke, jig, bonding, VP hardness, and process conditions.
Remove generated measurement statistics derived from headers, dates, item numbers, and quantities.
Use Sheet1 rows as plan/status/sample-size evidence only unless actual results are present.
Add Sheet2 data rows and module results as outcomes only where comparable conditions are clear.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they cite the wrong evidence for factors and outcomes; citations are insufficient for final use.
